scope: What Studio executes itself with bundled tools, what each tool needs from the host, what it delivers and what to deliver instead when a requirement is missing. Host tools and external providers are listed only to mark the boundary. A requirement is checked in the current host before a file is promised; a listed observation is past evidence, not a guarantee for another host or day.

host_profiles.code_execution: The conversation can run Python in a sandbox (ordinary ChatGPT or ChatGPT Work with code execution). Whether Node.js, ffmpeg, numpy or a browser exist there is checked by trying, not assumed.
host_profiles.shell: A local shell, for example Codex or a local project, usually with Python, Node.js 20 and sometimes a local Chrome or Chromium.
host_profiles.none: No code execution, for example voice or a host with code execution switched off. Studio writes text, contracts and prompts only.

capabilities.does: Sets exact copy, price, logo and legal lines on a generated, supplied or flat background in a bundled or user font; PNG or JPG at the exact size and a print PDF with bleed; stops on cropped text or missing glyphs and measures contrast
capabilities.delivers: PNG or JPG at the exact size, a print PDF with bleed when asked, the <id>.static.json spec and the <id>.audit.json text and contrast audit
capabilities.when_missing: Use one-pass generation with the exact copy in the prompt and inspect every letter of the render; say the exact-copy route was not available
capabilities.observed: 2026-10-10: container tests only

capabilities.does: Renders a motion contract to an MP4 (H.264, exact size, FPS and frame count)
capabilities.delivers: MP4 download link, the <id>.motion.json contract and the <id>.render.py script that rendered it
capabilities.when_missing: Deliver the contract and the motion player link; the user exports the video in the browser. An SVG logo without cairosvg: ask for a PNG of the mark
capabilities.observed: 2026-10-07: ChatGPT Work and ordinary ChatGPT delivered clean MP4s rendered from a contract (owner reports)

capabilities.does: Scores a contract and its rendered frames against the craft rubric and lists findings for the improvement round
capabilities.delivers: Critique score and findings before and after at most two repair rounds
capabilities.when_missing: Review the contract against motion craft by reading it and say the automatic critique was not run
capabilities.observed: 2026-10-08: run on the delivered video's frames in the container (checked, exit 0); host runs not recorded

capabilities.does: Designs effects and composes a music bed from the contract's timing, mixes, masters and checks every hit on its frame
capabilities.delivers: MP4 with sound, the sound plan, a cue table, the timing status and loudness in LUFS
capabilities.when_missing: Deliver the video silent and say so; offer the user's own audio file or a connected provider, never toy tones
capabilities.observed: 2026-10-08: ChatGPT Work delivered four videos with designed sound; steps 1 to 3 approved by ear by the owner

capabilities.does: Checks a motion contract: scene order, overlaps, copy references, captions, music and reading time
capabilities.delivers: PASS or the list of errors and warnings
capabilities.when_missing: Say the contract check was not run; check holds and caption timing against the motion craft rules by reading the contract
capabilities.observed: Container checks only

capabilities.does: Captures the contract's review frames in a browser and flags text outside the frame, clipped, below contrast or inside the margins
capabilities.delivers: review.json and a contact sheet with every frame and its findings
capabilities.when_missing: Use the critique on rendered frames where Python runs; otherwise inspect the planned frames by reading
capabilities.observed: Container checks only

capabilities.does: Checks that every visible word of any HTML composition (Studio preview, HyperFrames, GSAP) is complete inside the frame and every clipping ancestor in readable holds, without honouring audit-exempting flags
capabilities.delivers: text-audit.json and a phone-scale contact sheet with cut words outlined; exit code 1 when a word is cut in a hold
capabilities.when_missing: Inspect every readable hold at full size and phone scale by eye, word by word, and say the automatic text audit did not run; text completeness stays not verified
capabilities.observed: 2026-10-09: caught the reviewed reel's clipped decorative word with and without data-layout-ignore, passed complete Polish text and a transition mask (container, headless Chromium 1194); host runs not recorded

capabilities.does: Turns the existing evidence into four separate verdicts (technical, fidelity, composition, temporal) and an overall accepted, deliverable-with-limits or blocked
capabilities.delivers: acceptance.json listing what passed, failed and was not verified
capabilities.when_missing: Report the four verdicts by hand from the same evidence; anything not observed is NOT VERIFIED
capabilities.observed: 2026-10-09: blocked a technically valid MP4 whose word was cut, kept a contract-only score of 100 from passing composition (container); host runs not recorded

capabilities.does: Adds a music beat grid to a contract and imports SRT or WebVTT captions; reads and cuts a supplied track
capabilities.delivers: A synced contract with music, voice-over and captions on exact frames
capabilities.when_missing: Import the captions with the Python captions tool, or write them into the contract by hand from the SRT or WebVTT; set the beat grid from the stated tempo
capabilities.observed: Container checks only

capabilities.does: Changes a delivered contract without redesigning it and lists every change
capabilities.delivers: A new contract revision and its change list, rendered with the same script
capabilities.when_missing: Edit the contract directly, increment its revision and list the changes
capabilities.observed: 2026-10-07: ChatGPT Work revised a contract as asked and re-rendered it (owner report; whether revise.mjs ran is not recorded)

capabilities.does: Opens any motion contract in a browser for watching, and the player's Export video writes a video-only MP4 or WebM
capabilities.delivers: The contract plus the player link or file; the user's browser writes the video
capabilities.when_missing: Deliver the contract and its timing table
capabilities.observed: 2026-10-07: an Android phone browser exported a playable H.264 MP4 from the player (owner report)

capabilities.does: Measures the cuts of a supplied video and designs, mixes and checks its sound: hits on the moments the user marks, a music bed fitted to the shots, the video's own sound kept under ducking or replaced
capabilities.delivers: MP4 with the designed sound, the sound contract, a cue table, the timing status and loudness in LUFS
capabilities.when_missing: A picture-first sound plan from the measured or supplied cuts, with planned and measured times kept apart
capabilities.observed: 2026-10-08: container tests on a synthetic three-shot video (cuts found on their exact frames, every hit judged on its frame, about -14 LUFS delivered); no host run recorded

capabilities.does: Checks SRT and WebVTT against subtitle, social-caption or on-screen text limits, converts between them, builds cues from timed words or segments and imports them into a motion contract
capabilities.delivers: A checked SRT or WebVTT file with its report, or a motion contract with the captions
capabilities.when_missing: Write the cues against the readability defaults by hand and say the automatic check was not run
capabilities.observed: 2026-10-08: container tests only

capabilities.does: Burns captions into a supplied video in the motion renderer's caption style and copies the source audio unchanged
capabilities.delivers: MP4 with the captions burned in, and the caption file
capabilities.when_missing: Deliver the SRT or WebVTT file for the user's editor or the platform's caption upload
capabilities.observed: 2026-10-08: container tests on a synthetic video only

capabilities.does: Renders the Remotion kinetic type starter or a Remotion project with exact dependency pins
capabilities.delivers: A rendered MP4 from the Remotion project
capabilities.when_missing: Use the Python renderer for the same contract, or deliver the project and its commands
capabilities.observed: Container checks only

capabilities.does: HeyGen's open HyperFrames framework, installed on request in a shell host, builds and renders HTML compositions: launch films from a website, longer narrated videos, word-level captions, music-driven edits
capabilities.delivers: An MP4 rendered by HyperFrames from the approved brief, reviewed by the Motion Graphics Workflow before delivery
capabilities.when_missing: The bundled route: the Python renderer or the motion player, with Studio's sound design and captions tool
capabilities.observed: 2026-10-09: the owner reported a high-quality reel made in the HyperFrames Studio app from a shop link; no HyperFrames render has run through Studio

capabilities.does: Generates or edits an image with the host's own image tool when the host exposes one
capabilities.delivers: The host's generated image, inspected before it is called a result
capabilities.when_missing: Deliver the final prompt as a standalone code block for the user's own tool
capabilities.observed: 2026-10-08: ordinary ChatGPT generated storyboard boards on request (owner report)

capabilities.does: Video generators such as Veo, Gemini Omni, Kling, Seedance, Wan, MiniMax H3 or Runway run outside Studio; the dated video-generator snapshot in Research Evidence maps them
capabilities.delivers: A prompt for the named generator, researched for its current version and surface
capabilities.when_missing: Deliver the prompt; review a clip the user supplies

capabilities.when_missing: Deliver the packet; for a motion video Studio renders or a video the user supplies, the motion sound engine designs the sound instead where code runs

capabilities.does: Reads current sources when the conditional research gate triggers
capabilities.delivers: An evidence note with sources and access dates

capabilities.observed: Depends on the host's search or browsing tool

capabilities.does: Searches the open skills.sh catalog with its security audits and reads a candidate's SKILL.md description; installs nothing
capabilities.delivers: Catalog candidates with what they do, installs, audits, verdict and an install command run only on explicit request
capabilities.when_missing: Match the need against Studio's own skills and give the skills.sh link with search keywords; Codex and Claude Code can search and install from it

capabilities.does: Builds and renders an illustrated procedural canvas film with the bundled Animate engine (seven styles or one matched from references) and measures it with the engine's review
capabilities.delivers: An MP4 in each requested format with a composed score, contact sheets and the review's measured checks
capabilities.when_missing: Plan the piece with the engine's grammar and render the idea through the contract with the Python renderer, or deliver the piece files and the commands
capabilities.observed: Container checks only
